Raman then explicitly requested that the 200-card order be proceeded with, provided Vijayawada as the address, and asked for the internal order request to be processed; payment would be handled later. The agent confirmed that the enquiry was saved and said payment would be discussed after the designs were received. Raman had no further questions and ended the call politely. The transcript does not explicitly confirm that the internal order request was processed or that payment was made.
